crossRefs.note: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
Let’s acknowledge Yahweh. Let’s press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come…
He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken…
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

translations.web: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
translations.bsb: Instruct a wise man, and he will be wiser still; teach a righteous man, and he will increase his learning.
translations.kjv: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
translations.asv: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.
